measures.description: A modeled estimate of subjective happiness (0–100) given the area's circumstantial composition — income, marital/household status, employment, home ownership, and health. Not an observed local survey.

measures.label: Daily leisure time (modeled)
measures.description: Modeled average minutes of daily leisure — socializing, relaxing, TV, sports and exercise — expected given the area's circumstantial composition. A synthetic estimate, not a local time-diary survey.
measures.source: American Time Use Survey, small-area estimated

measures.label: Life feels exciting % (modeled)
measures.description: Modeled share of adults expected to describe their life as exciting (vs routine or dull), given the area's circumstantial composition. A synthetic estimate, not an observed survey.

measures.label: No religious affiliation % (modeled)
measures.description: Modeled share of adults expected to report no religious affiliation, given the area's demographic and circumstantial composition. A synthetic estimate, not an observed survey.

measures.label: Very happy % (modeled)
measures.description: Modeled share of adults expected to report being 'very happy' given the area's circumstantial composition. A synthetic estimate, not an observed survey.

measures.label: Social trust (modeled)
measures.description: Modeled share of adults expected to say most people can be trusted, given the area's circumstantial composition. A synthetic estimate, not an observed survey.

measures.label: Strongly religious % (modeled)
measures.description: Modeled share of adults expected to call their religious affiliation strong, given the area's demographic and circumstantial composition. A synthetic estimate, not an observed survey.

measures.label: Time poverty (modeled)
measures.description: Modeled share of adults expected to get under two hours of daily leisure — the time-poor. A synthetic estimate, not a local survey.
measures.source: American Time Use Survey, small-area estimated

measures.label: Weekly attenders % (modeled)
measures.description: Modeled share of adults expected to attend religious services nearly weekly or more, given the area's demographic and circumstantial composition. A synthetic estimate, not an observed survey.

measures.label: At a bar weekly % (modeled)
measures.description: Modeled share of adults expected to visit a bar or tavern weekly or more. The most caveated of the modeled socializing metrics — mostly a density gradient.

measures.label: Sees friends weekly % (modeled)
measures.description: Modeled share of adults expected to spend an evening with friends weekly or more, given the area's circumstantial composition and density. Synthetic estimate.

measures.label: Socializes with neighbors weekly % (modeled)
measures.description: Modeled share of adults expected to spend an evening with neighbors weekly or more, given the area's circumstantial composition and density. Synthetic estimate.

measures.label: Multilingual Homes

measures.label: Museums
measures.description: Mapped museums assigned to the ward.

measures.source: CPS Civic Engagement and Volunteering Supplement / ACS covariates

measures.label: Housing Construction Investment
measures.description: Reported construction cost of new residential building permits issued each year.

measures.label: New Housing Permits
measures.description: Likely residential new-construction building permits issued each year.

measures.label: New Homes Permitted (est.)
measures.description: Estimated new dwelling units permitted each year.

measures.label: Noise Complaints
measures.description: Noise complaints to the city per 10,000 residents each year.
measures.source: Chicago Department of Public Health environmental complaints (city portal)

measures.label: Bills Sponsored
measures.description: Non-routine bills sponsored by alders associated with the ward in the configured Councilmatic session.

measures.label: National Register listings
measures.description: National Register of Historic Places entries (districts and individual listings) in the area.
measures.source: National Register of Historic Places (Chicago portal extract)

measures.label: Rent (Zillow ZORI, asking)
measures.description: Typical monthly asking rent for homes listed for rent.

measures.label: Parking lots
measures.description: Mapped off-street parking lots and garages per square km (does not include street parking).

measures.label: Open Late
measures.description: Gathering places open at 9pm on weekdays, per 10,000 residents.
measures.source: Google Maps via Apify third-places sweeps

measures.label: Opioid Overdose Deaths
measures.description: Deaths the Cook County Medical Examiner flagged as opioid-related, per 10,000 residents each year.
measures.source: Cook County Medical Examiner case archive

measures.label: Park Access
measures.description: Chicago Park District acres available per 10,000 residents.
measures.source: Chicago Park District parks data plus ACS population estimates

measures.label: Parks
measures.description: Mapped parks assigned to the ward.

measures.label: Water Fountain Lead
measures.description: Share of Chicago Park District park fountain sites with any historically elevated lead result.

measures.label: Park District Programs
measures.description: Park District classes and activities currently listed in the area, per 10,000 residents.

measures.label: Parking Complaints
measures.description: Abandoned-vehicle and bike-lane parking 311 complaints per square km (since 2023).

measures.label: Parking Difficulty
measures.description: How contested parking is, proxied by parking complaints' share of all local 311 activity.

measures.label: Participatory budgeting
measures.description: Whether the ward lets residents vote on its menu-money spending (participatory budgeting); at finer geographies, the share of the area governed by a PB ward.
measures.source: UIC Great Cities Institute; City Cast Chicago; ward sites

measures.label: Pedestrian & cyclist crashes
measures.description: Crashes where the first impact was with a person walking or biking.
measures.source: Traffic Crashes (Chicago Police via city portal)

measures.label: Per-Pupil Spending
measures.description: Site-level school spending per student, enrollment-weighted.

measures.label: Permit-Zone Density
measures.description: Residential permit-zone block faces per square km (parking scarcity signal).

measures.label: Pharmacies
measures.description: Pharmacies and drug stores per 10,000 residents — annual County Business Patterns establishments.

measures.label: Inactivity
measures.description: Adults reporting no leisure-time physical activity.

measures.label: Places
measures.description: Mapped civic, cultural, and public places assigned to the ward.

measures.label: Fine Particles (citizen sensors)
measures.description: Annual mean PM2.5 (µg/m³) from citizen sensors with the EPA correction, smoothed to the area.

measures.label: Poor/Fair Health
measures.description: Adults reporting fair or poor general health.

measures.label: Poverty Rate
measures.description: Residents whose income in the past 12 months is below the poverty level.

measures.label: Property Crime
measures.description: Reported property crimes per 10,000 residents: theft, burglary, motor vehicle theft, robbery, arson and criminal damage, the FBI's NIBRS crimes against property (fraud is left out: it is recorded where it's reported, not where it happened).
measures.source: Chicago Data Portal crime records and ACS population estimates

measures.label: Public Transit
measures.description: Workers commuting by public transportation, excluding taxicabs.

measures.label: Citizen Air Sensors
measures.description: PurpleAir sensors per 10,000 residents: households publishing their own air and temperature readings.

measures.label: Real-estate sales
measures.description: Recorded property sale dollars per year at parcel precision — transaction spending with only a recording lag.

measures.label: Rent Burden
measures.description: Renter households spending 30 percent or more of household income on gross rent.

measures.label: Renovation investment
measures.description: Reported construction cost of residential renovation permits — reinvestment in existing housing.

measures.label: Home Renovation Permits
measures.description: Likely residential renovation and alteration permits issued each year.

measures.label: Near a Plate Reader
measures.description: Share of residents who live within a quarter mile of a license-plate-reading camera.

measures.label: Restaurants (County Business Patterns)
measures.description: Table-service restaurants per 10,000 residents — annual County Business Patterns establishments.

measures.label: Rezonings Passed
measures.description: Zoning map changes the City Council passed per square kilometer in the year.

measures.label: Multifamily Rezonings
measures.description: Of the year's rezonings, the share that newly allowed apartment buildings (3+ units).

measures.label: Upzoning Share
measures.description: Of the year's rezonings, the share that raised how much building the lot allows.

measures.label: Ride-share spending
measures.description: Dollars spent on ride-share trips starting in the area per year — consumer spending, current to about five weeks.
measures.source: Transportation Network Provider trip records (City of Chicago)

measures.label: Small Business Grant Dollars
measures.description: Dollars of Small Business Improvement Fund grants approved in the area each year.
measures.source: Chicago Small Business Improvement Fund grants (city portal)

measures.label: Small Business Grants
measures.description: Small Business Improvement Fund grants approved in the area each year.
measures.source: Chicago Small Business Improvement Fund grants (city portal)

measures.label: School Proficiency
measures.description: Students meeting ELA/math state standards at area schools.

measures.label: Scofflaw Buildings Listed
measures.description: Buildings added to the city's Building Code Scofflaw List each year.
measures.source: Chicago Building Code Scofflaw List (city portal)

measures.label: Sewer Cave-Ins
measures.description: Sewer cave-in inspection requests per 10,000 residents.

measures.label: Sewer Cleaning
measures.description: Sewer cleaning inspection requests per 10,000 residents.

measures.label: Sewer Trouble
measures.description: Sewer cleaning and cave-in inspection requests per 10,000 residents.

measures.label: Shooting Victims
measures.description: People shot (killed or wounded) per 10,000 residents each year, from CPD's victims file.
measures.source: Chicago Police violence reduction victims (city portal)

measures.label: Short Sleep
measures.description: Share of adults sleeping less than 7 hours on average.

measures.label: Civic Engagement
measures.description: ZIP/ZCTA proxy for volunteering and civic participation.

measures.label: Social Cohesion
measures.description: ZIP/ZCTA proxy for cohesive local social networks.

measures.label: Social Support
measures.description: Share of adults estimated to have needed social and emotional support.

measures.label: Speed Camera Tickets
measures.description: Speed camera tickets issued per 10,000 residents each year. Reflects where the cameras are as much as how fast people drive.

measures.label: Street Flooding
measures.description: Water-on-street 311 requests per 10,000 residents.

measures.label: Summer Afternoon Sensor Temperature
measures.description: Typical noon–3 pm summer reading from citizen sensors (°C). Sun-exposed housings run hot; read as a heat-exposure signal, not air temperature.

measures.label: Summer Night Air Temperature
measures.description: Typical 2–5 am summer air temperature (°C), smoothed from citizen sensors and airport stations.

measures.label: Summer Night Humidity
measures.description: Typical 2–5 am summer relative humidity (%), smoothed from citizen sensors and airport stations.

measures.label: Summer Sun
measures.description: Ground-level direct-sun share on the summer solstice (June 21).

measures.label: Summer Surface Temperature
measures.description: Typical summer late-morning ground and roof temperature from Landsat, not air temperature (°C).
measures.source: USGS Landsat via Microsoft Planetary Computer

measures.label: Hottest Surfaces
measures.description: What the area's hottest 5% of ground and roofs reach in a typical summer late morning, not air temperature (°C).
measures.source: USGS Landsat via Microsoft Planetary Computer

measures.label: Third Places
measures.description: Gathering places — cafés, bars, restaurants, gyms, bookstores — per 10,000 residents.
measures.source: Google Maps via Apify third-places sweeps

measures.label: All businesses (County Business Patterns)
measures.description: Employer establishments of every industry per 10,000 residents — annual County Business Patterns establishments.

measures.label: Trade & Vocational Schools
measures.description: Certificate schools of less than two years located here.

measures.label: Traffic injuries
measures.description: People injured in police-reported traffic crashes in the area each year.
measures.source: Traffic Crashes (Chicago Police via city portal)

measures.label: Traffic Deaths & Serious Injuries
measures.description: People killed or incapacitated in police-reported traffic crashes each year.
measures.source: Traffic Crashes (Chicago Police via city portal)

measures.label: Tree Planting Requests
measures.description: 311 parkway tree planting requests per 10,000 residents.

measures.label: Uninsured
measures.description: Civilian noninstitutionalized residents without health insurance coverage.

measures.label: Vacant Building Complaints
measures.description: 311 vacant or abandoned building complaints per 10,000 residents.

measures.label: Vacant Lot Cleanup Requests
measures.description: 311 requests to clean a vacant lot per 10,000 residents.

measures.label: Cars per Household
measures.description: Average vehicles available per household (parking demand).

measures.label: Violent Crime
measures.description: Reported violent crimes per 10,000 residents. Violent follows the FBI's NIBRS standard — homicide, sexual assault, assault, battery — which classes robbery as a crime against property (the older UCR summary index counted robbery as violent).
measures.source: Chicago Data Portal crime records and ACS population estimates

measures.label: Voter Turnout
measures.description: Ballots cast as a share of registered voters.
measures.source: Chicago municipal election results via DataMade / Chicago Board of Elections

measures.label: Water Lead Test Requests
measures.description: Free water lead test kit and visit requests per 10,000 residents.

measures.label: Winter Sun
measures.description: Ground-level direct-sun share on the winter solstice (December 21), when shadows are longest.

measures.label: Faith Diversity
measures.description: Variety of religious traditions among the area's houses of worship.
measures.source: Google Maps via Apify third-places sweeps

measures.label: Worship Rating
measures.description: Median Google rating of the area's houses of worship.
measures.source: Google Maps via Apify third-places sweeps

measures.label: Worship Places
measures.description: Houses of worship per 10,000 residents, across every tradition.
measures.source: Google Maps via Apify third-places sweeps

measures.label: Beloved Congregations
measures.description: Worship places rated 4.8+ with 25+ reviews.
measures.source: Google Maps via Apify third-places sweeps

measures.label: Worship Engagement
measures.description: Google reviews of worship places per 10,000 residents.
measures.source: Google Maps via Apify third-places sweeps

measures.label: Yoga & pilates studios
measures.description: Yoga and pilates studios per 10,000 residents.

measures.label: Business Zoning
measures.description: Share of the area's zoned land in business or commercial districts, where shops and offices may go.

measures.label: Zoned Capacity Added
measures.description: Net floor area that the year's rezonings added to what the zoning allows, in square feet per km².

measures.label: Zoned FAR
measures.description: How much building the zoning allows, on average: floor area per square foot of land.

measures.label: Manufacturing Zoning
measures.description: Share of the area's zoned land set aside for industry.

measures.label: Multifamily Zoning
measures.description: Share of the area's zoned land in residential districts that allow two-flats, townhouses and apartment buildings.

measures.label: Planned Developments
measures.description: Share of the area's zoned land under a Planned Development, rules negotiated for one large project.

measures.label: Single-Family Zoning
measures.description: Share of the area's zoned land where only houses may be built, no apartment buildings.
